mapper.select: SELECT USER_LOGIN_VALID_PARTY_ROLE.*, PG.party_id AS PG_party_id, PG.group_name AS PG_group_name, PG.group_name_local AS PG_group_name_local, PG.office_site_name AS PG_office_site_name, PG.annual_revenue AS PG_annual_revenue, PG.num_employees AS PG_num_employees, PG.ticker_symbol AS PG_ticker_symbol, PG.comments AS PG_comments, PG.logo_image_url AS PG_logo_image_url, PG.last_updated_stamp AS PG_last_updated_stamp, PG.last_updated_tx_stamp AS PG_last_updated_tx_stamp, PG.created_stamp AS PG_created_stamp, PG.created_tx_stamp AS PG_created_tx_stamp, PG.year_statistic_data AS PG_year_statistic_data, PG.annual_turnover AS PG_annual_turnover, PG.group_name_lang AS PG_group_name_lang, PG.last_modified_by_user_login AS PG_last_modified_by_user_login, PG.created_by_user_login AS PG_created_by_user_login FROM USER_LOGIN_VALID_PARTY_ROLE INNER JOIN PARTY_GROUP PG ON PG.PARTY_ID = USER_LOGIN_VALID_PARTY_ROLE.PARTY_ID WHERE USER_LOGIN_VALID_PARTY_ROLE.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{user}
